scientific_integrity: All-parameter proof supplied using Apéry thresholds and maximal-run boundary equivalence; finite exact checks are corroboration, not a substitute. Earliest cited public motivating version is 2022-06-27.

title: Affine rigidity of the complete gap-run spectrum of two-generator numerical semigroups
